verses.zh: 人屡次受责罚，仍然硬着颈项；他必顷刻败坏，无法可治。
verses.kjv: He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.
verses.en: Someone corrected again and again who still stiffens his neck will be broken suddenly, past mending.

verses.zh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。
verses.kjv: When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice: but when the wicked beareth rule, the people mourn.
verses.en: When good people are in charge, the people are glad; when bad people rule, the people groan.

verses.zh: 爱慕智慧的，使父亲喜乐；与妓女结交的，却浪费钱财。
verses.kjv: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father: but he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth his substance.
verses.en: Whoever loves wisdom makes his father glad, but keeping bad company wastes his money.

verses.zh: 王借公平，使国坚定；索要贿赂，使国倾败。
verses.kjv: The king by judgment establisheth the land: but he that receiveth gifts overthroweth it.
verses.en: A king makes a country steady by being fair, but demanding bribes tears it down.

verses.zh: 谄媚邻舍的，就是设网罗绊他的脚。
verses.kjv: A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his feet.
verses.en: Flattering your neighbour is spreading a net in front of their feet.

verses.zh: 恶人犯罪，自陷网罗；惟独义人欢呼喜乐。
verses.kjv: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare: but the righteous doth sing and rejoice.
verses.en: Bad people are trapped by their own wrongdoing, but good people sing and are glad.

verses.zh: 义人知道查明穷人的案；恶人没有聪明，就不得而知。
verses.kjv: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor: but the wicked regardeth not to know it.
verses.en: A good person cares about justice for the poor, but a bad person does not even want to know.

verses.zh: 亵慢人煽惑通城；智慧人止息众怒。
verses.kjv: Scornful men bring a city into a snare: but wise men turn away wrath.
verses.en: Mockers set a whole city alight, but wise people calm anger down.

verses.zh: 智慧人与愚妄人相争，或怒或笑，总不能使他止息。
verses.kjv: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man, whether he rage or laugh, there is no rest.
verses.en: When a wise person argues with a fool, the fool rages or laughs and there is no peace.

verses.zh: 好流人血的，恨恶完全人，索取正直人的性命。
verses.kjv: The bloodthirsty hate the upright: but the just seek his soul.
verses.en: Violent people hate an honest person, but the upright care about his life.

verses.zh: 愚妄人怒气全发；智慧人忍气含怒。
verses.kjv: A fool uttereth all his mind: but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards.
verses.en: A fool lets out everything he feels, but a wise person holds it back.

verses.zh: 君王若听谎言，他一切臣仆都是奸恶。
verses.kjv: If a ruler hearken to lies, all his servants are wicked.
verses.en: If a ruler listens to lies, all his officials turn out wicked.

verses.zh: 贫穷人、强暴人在世相遇；他们的眼目都蒙耶和华光照。
verses.kjv: The poor and the deceitful man meet together: the LORD lighteneth both their eyes.
verses.en: A poor person and an oppressor have this in common: the LORD gives light to both their eyes.

verses.zh: 君王凭诚实判断穷人；他的国位必永远坚立。
verses.kjv: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, his throne shall be established for ever.
verses.en: If a king judges the poor honestly, his throne will stand firm for ever.

verses.zh: 杖打和责备能加增智慧；放纵的儿子使母亲羞愧。
verses.kjv: The rod and reproof give wisdom: but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame.
verses.en: Correction gives wisdom, but a child left to himself shames his mother.

verses.zh: 恶人加多，过犯也加多，义人必看见他们跌倒。
verses.kjv: When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increaseth: but the righteous shall see their fall.
verses.en: When bad people increase, so does wrongdoing, but good people will see them fall.

verses.zh: 管教你的儿子，他就使你得安息，也必使你心里喜乐。
verses.kjv: Correct thy son, and he shall give thee rest; yea, he shall give delight unto thy soul.
verses.en: Correct your child and he will give you peace; he will bring joy to your heart.

verses.zh: 没有异象，民就放肆；惟遵守律法的，便为有福。
verses.kjv: Where there is no vision, the people perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.
verses.en: Where nobody sees what God is showing, people run wild — but whoever keeps the law is happy.

verses.zh: 只用言语，仆人不肯受管教；他虽然明白，也不留意。
verses.kjv: A servant will not be corrected by words: for though he understand he will not answer.
verses.en: A servant will not be corrected by words alone; he may understand and still not act.

verses.zh: 你见言语急躁的人吗？愚昧人比他更有指望。
verses.kjv: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
verses.en: Do you see someone who speaks without thinking? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

verses.zh: 人将仆人从小娇养，这仆人终久必成了他的儿子。
verses.kjv: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child shall have him become his son at the length.
verses.en: Spoil a servant from childhood, and in the end he will act as if he owns the place.

verses.zh: 好气的人挑启争端；暴怒的人多多犯罪。
verses.kjv: An angry man stirreth up strife, and a furious man aboundeth in transgression.
verses.en: A hot-tempered person starts quarrels, and an angry one does plenty of wrong.

verses.zh: 人的高傲必使他卑下；心里谦逊的，必得尊荣。
verses.kjv: A man’s pride shall bring him low: but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit.
verses.en: Pride brings a person low, but a humble spirit gains honour.

verses.zh: 人与盗贼分赃，是恨恶自己的性命；他听见叫人发誓的声音，却不言语。
verses.kjv: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul: he heareth cursing, and bewrayeth it not.
verses.en: Sharing with a thief means hating your own life; you hear the oath and say nothing.

verses.zh: 惧怕人的，陷入网罗；惟有倚靠耶和华的，必得安稳。
verses.kjv: The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in the LORD shall be safe.
verses.en: Being afraid of people is a trap, but whoever trusts the LORD is safe.

verses.zh: 求王恩的人多；定人事乃在耶和华。
verses.kjv: Many seek the ruler’s favour; but every man’s judgment cometh from the LORD.
verses.en: Many people want the ruler's favour, but it is the LORD who decides what is fair.

verses.zh: 为非作歹的，被义人憎嫌；行事正直的，被恶人憎恶。
verses.kjv: An unjust man is an abomination to the just: and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked.
verses.en: Good people cannot stand what is unfair, and bad people cannot stand someone honest.
